findings.text: The directory scan and record cache at reckon/crew/findings.py:309-481 duplicate the review-store index refresh mechanism owned by reckon/crew/review_records.py: _stat_identity (1049), _build_store_entries (1135) and _update_store_entries (1168, which already embodies keep-if-unchanged / re-read-if-identity-moved / drop-if-vanished) own this capability, and _store_indexes (1318) persists it. The addition duplicates the owner rather than extending it, so a second index over the same store must now be kept correct independently.

The _code_review_rows docstring at line 418 claims the rows are memoised against the record's own file so a code review is read once and re-read only when its file moves, but the function holds no memo: _stored_code_reviews -> plan_review.list_code_reviews already reads each code-*.json, and line 427 reads the same file a second time through _committed_record_at (reckon/crew/review_records.py:98) on every call. The claim is false and every code review is parsed twice per findings_by_path call.

The index stores row dicts and hands them out by reference: line 474 does rows.extend(cached[1]), and findings_by_path at lines 519 and 532 places the same objects into artefacts, rows and group rows. reckon/file_memo.py:1-10 states the repository rule that callers receive a copy so mutating a returned value never poisons a shared entry; a caller that annotates a returned row here corrupts the index for every later read until that record's file moves. No current caller mutates the rows, so the defect is latent rather than live.

justifications.durability: Reinstating a whole-store read reddens the empty-instrument assertion at tests/test_findings_are_indexed_by_path.py:108 and the exactly-one-record assertion at :126, and serving a deleted record's cached rows reddens :151-152; the recorded negative control shows all three failing together.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_findings_are_indexed_by_path.py:95-152 holds the three done-when facts and logs/negative-control.log records all three failing with EXIT=1 when the memo is dropped, while timer-after.log records warm=1.329s against the 2 s target.
justifications.fit: The neighbouring readers of the same store in reckon/crew/findings.py follow its existing stat-and-read shape, but the new _code_review_rows docstring at line 418 claims a memo the code does not have.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/findings.py:466-474 keeps each unchanged record's rows and re-reads only where its identity moved, so a second findings_by_path call opens no record while grouping, recurrence and artefacts stay unchanged.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/review_records.py:1168 _update_store_entries already owns refreshing a review-store index by stat identity, and reckon/crew/findings.py:462-474 re-implements that rule for finding rows instead of extending the owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 45e23304..1ba5fc91 lists only reckon/crew/findings.py, tests/test_findings_are_indexed_by_path.py and the landing fragment.
